latestRun.verification: GitHub/source review only; no Unity runtime or native capture was available. The prior async reflection waiter already proved one physical SummerSun/sky/ambient/shadow SHA-256 across request, every observed Editor poll, completion and immediate pre-still, but that proof did not bind active renderer transforms, meshes, current material serialization or texture bindings. Added reflection-render-state-v1 SHA-256 over the persisted benchmark scene dependency hash, deterministic active renderer hierarchy/type, world transforms/bounds and render state, mesh asset/runtime invariants, current material serialization and common PBR/detail texture dependency/sampling state. The outer reflection-lighting-state-v2 hash now folds this render-state hash into the existing waiter, so the existing request/poll/completion/pre-still equality checks fail closed on either lighting or renderable-state drift. Source material/texture/texel/albedo/metadata/primitive validators are required before a changed render state is accepted as a new baseline. Renderer MaterialPropertyBlock overrides are currently rejected rather than partially fingerprinted, because they can override per-renderer or per-material shader values without changing shared Material state. Unity 6 API documentation was checked for the Renderer/Mesh/Texture APIs used, but no compile/runtime assertion is made.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Material/PBR: prevents stale reflection evidence after shared material/shader/texture changes; cannot award points without actual angular-response pixels.
Lighting/shadows/reflections: extends cubemap/still coherence from physical illumination alone to reflected renderable scene/material state.
Texture/microdetail: binds common PBR/detail texture assignment, dependency and sampling state across the async reflection boundary.
Geometry & construction: binds active renderer transforms/bounds and mesh invariants, reducing stale cubemap reuse after object movement/replacement.
Weathering and Cinematic image: prevents a stable SummerSun hash from masking a changed residue/material state before still evidence.

Critical defects: hidden MaterialPropertyBlock overrides are fail-closed until explicitly fingerprinted; hash equality still cannot clear baked highlights, impossible physics, repetition, geometry intersection or light leak without pixel review.
